༄༅/ /lcags sdig gi phrin las snying po bsdus pa las/mngon rtogs rgyun 'khyer du bya ba mdor bsdus pa sa bcad tsam zhig bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lcags sdig gi phrin las snying po bsdus pa las/ mngon rtogs rgyun 'khyer du bya ba mdor bsdus pa sa bcad tsam zhig bzhugs so//

yang yul dang skabs kyi mngon rtogs mdor bsdus rkang grangs tsam mi byed ka med byung na/ phye bas rang rig e ru shar/ bh+rūṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ drag po sgrol byed tshogs su gyur// ces pa'i bar dor nas/ a+ye las e yaṃ baṃ suṃ raṃ// keṃ chad mkha' rlung chu sa me// ri rab steng du rang rig e// e ka tsa ti'i thugs kar bh+yo/ e a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ sa bon sngags las 'od 'phros pas// snod bcud 'od zhu don gnyis byas// yongs gyur dur khrod 'bar ba'i dbus// me ri dur khrod pad rdor nang*// 'obs chen bcu drug dbus su bh+rūṃ// de las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter// dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang*// 'jigs rngam rab 'bar dbus gru gsum// zla gam gsum dang rtsibs bzhi brgyad// lcags dang thod mkhar 'bar ba rdzogs// dbus su klu gnyan sa bdag dang*// phyogs skyong ma he glang pad+ma// nyi zla'i gdan la rang rig rtsal// rang shar zil gnon ha la'i mdog /nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal rngam zhing*// phyag drug 'khor lo gri rdo rje| |be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub me// zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gar dgu'i nyams// dur khrod chas sogs khyung seng stag /sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka ru// ya ma smug nag g.yas 'khor lo// dregs pa ljang nag rdo rje g.yas// g.yon gnyis tsit+ta'i phreng ba 'dzin// khyams khong rnams dang spyi bor khyung*// pang ngam g.yon du be tā nag /khro chas tsit+ta bhan+dha thogs// g.yon dang g.yas su dbyings sgrol yum// zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum// rtsibs bzhir gshed chen rnam pa bzhi// rtsibs brgyad phyi nang gshed po brgyad// gru chad 'chi bdag bcu gnyis tshogs// khyams la gshin rje sum cu gnyis// sgo bzhir thun gyi bdag po bzhi// phyi khyams gshin rje bdun cu dang*// rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma'i tshogs// mu khyud 'obs srung bcu drug bcas// mkha' la glog ltar skad cig gsal// zhes mos/

spyan 'dren byin 'bebs dkyus bzhin no// yang bstod pa bsdus pa spro na/ a+ye/ chos dbyings ngang las rang mdangs snying rje'i rtsal// gang 'dul der ston phyag rgya zil gyis gnon// rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang*// dbyings sgrol yum dang sprul pa rnam pa gsum// gshed chen mon pa bdud rnam bzhi bzhir bcas// 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gshin rje sum cu gnyis// sgo skyong rnam bzhi gshin rje bdun brgya dang*// nyi shu 'obs srung bcu drug yang sprul bcas// rang rig rang mdangs gcig nyid du mar snang*// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyi rnam rol ba// lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul bcas la bstod// ces pa tsam dang*/ shin tu bsdus par spro na mchod pa rnams kyang sngags tsam gyis rung la/ de ltar rgyun 'khyer rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang skyabs sems rjes su ting 'dzin rnam gsum man chad bya'o// zhes pa'ang rtsom pa po sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjes smras so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
